title: Tailwise Grooming Salon Satisfaction Redo
content:
**The redo promise.** A customer unhappy with the cut or finish of a completed Tailwise Grooming Salon visit may have the same service redone free at a Tailwise salon. A redo is free only if it is requested no later than the pass's redo window after the original visit date. The redo window is counted in calendar days from the appointment date of the completed visit, that date being day 0; a request on the last day is in time. The visit has fewer redos than the pass's redo allowance per visit. A redo uses no visit and carries no surcharges; add-ons are not redone. Dissatisfaction with the price, matting found at a later date, or an injury report is not a redo matter.

**Evidence.** The original visit date and the redos already recorded against that visit are read from the salon history of the pass; the redo is tied to that one completed visit.

**Redo terms by pass**

| Pass | Redo window (calendar days after the visit) | Free redos per completed visit |
|---|---|---|
| Express Bath Pass 3-Visit | 7 | 1 |
| Bath & Tidy Pass 4-Visit | 7 | 1 |
| Full Groom Pass 4-Visit | 7 | 1 |
| Full Groom Pass 6-Visit | 7 | 1 |
| Spa Groom Pass 6-Visit | 10 | 1 |
| Groom Club Monthly | 7 | 1 |

**Window on the boundary (hypothetical visit on 1 March, day 0)**

| Pass | Last day in time | Request on that day | Request one day later |
|---|---|---|---|
| Full Groom Pass 6-Visit (7 days) | 8 March | in time | not in time |
| Spa Groom Pass 6-Visit (10 days) | 11 March | in time | not in time |

**Checklist of conditions — all must hold for a free redo**

| Condition | Read from |
|---|---|
| the concern is the cut or finish of a completed visit | the customer's request |
| requested no later than the last day of the window | the completed visit's appointment date |
| the visit has fewer redos than the allowance (with an allowance of 1: no redo yet) | redos recorded against that visit |

**What the redo carries.** No visit is used, no surcharge is charged, and add-ons booked on the original visit are not performed again.
